settings.label: Controller display
settings.help: Live pad graphic top-left: buttons, sticks and triggers light up as pressed (Xbox or PlayStation labels per the button style). Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Controller display X
settings.help: Horizontal position of the controller display. 0 is the left edge, 100 is the right (percent of the free screen). Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Controller display Y
settings.help: Vertical position of the controller display. 0 is the top, 100 is the bottom (percent of the free screen). Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Controller display size
settings.help: Size of the controller display (1 = about 160 px wide at 1080p). Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Controller display opacity
settings.help: Opacity of the controller display. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Controller display pressed colour
settings.help: Colour of buttons, sticks and triggers while pressed on the controller display. Applies now. Save to keep it (the ini also takes a hex RRGGBB).

settings.label: Input display (history)
settings.help: Input history panel (newest on top): frames held, direction arrow and buttons, like a fighting-game training mode. Read-only; reads the pad, never touches saves. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Input display side
settings.help: Which side of the screen the input history sits on. Left is below the FPS overlay. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Input display rows
settings.help: How many history rows the input display shows (stops above the game's bottom HUD). Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Hide game HUD
settings.help: Hides the game's own HUD (health / ki bars, minimap, shortcuts, money, boss gauge) for clean screenshots and videos. The game's menus still show. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Hide health / ki bars
settings.help: Hides only the player's health, ki and third gauge (one game widget, so they hide together). Works with or without Hide game HUD. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Hide style crest
settings.help: Hides only the Samurai/Ninja style crest and line under the health bars. Works with or without Hide game HUD. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Hide stance
settings.help: Hides only the stance figure (high/mid/low) at the bottom right. Works with or without Hide game HUD. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Hide item / skill shortcuts
settings.help: Hides only the item and ninjutsu / onmyo shortcut icons. Works with or without Hide game HUD. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Hide guardian spirit
settings.help: Hides only the guardian spirit (Living Weapon) gauge. Works with or without Hide game HUD. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Hide amrita
settings.help: Hides only the amrita counter at the far right of the bottom row (the large number next to it is money). Works with or without Hide game HUD. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Hide money
settings.help: Hides only the money counter (the large number in the bottom row). Works with or without Hide game HUD. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Hide boss bar
settings.help: Hides only the boss health gauge. Works with or without Hide game HUD. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Hide minimap
settings.help: Hides only the minimap. Works with or without Hide game HUD. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Hide enemy health bars
settings.help: Hides only the small health bars over normal enemies (the boss bar has its own row). Works with or without Hide game HUD. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Hide lock-on marker
settings.help: Hides only the lock-on circle on the targeted enemy. Works with or without Hide game HUD. Applies now. Save to keep it.

settings.label: Hide HUD widget ids
